dedupe_keys.name: dataset for study efficiency in building energy use pattern discovery and crisis identification in hot water consumption data

description: Dataset for study: ‘Efficiency in Building Energy Use: Pattern Discovery and Crisis Identification in Hot-Water Consumption data’ is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Lina Morkūnaitė, Darius Pupeikis (Kauno Technologijos Universitetas). This dataset contains time-series data on energy consumption for hot-water preparation from 10 residential apartment buildings in Kaunas, Lithuania. These buildings are connected to the city's central district heating system. The data collection period varies across buildings, with the longest spanning 10 years, from 2011 to 2021. Coverage: national (LT); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
